body.name: muH
body.def: \(\mu_H(\zeta)=(|R|,|\Sigma|,|\mathcal F|,|\mathcal L|,|\mathcal R|)\), ordered lexicographically. A selector transition removes one element of \(\Sigma\) without changing \(R\); a fixing transition removes one vertex from \(R\); an elimination transition either removes a nonempty \(Z\subseteq R\) or consumes one \(\ell\)-token without changing earlier coordinates; and a residual transition consumes the sole residual token and halts.
